method: a flange of angle th, outer leg length Hf (height, from the virtual sharp along the flange) bends with allowance BA = th(R+Kt) and bend deduction BD = 2(R+t)tan(th/2) - BA; unfolded it lies in the base's plane and reaches Hf - BD beyond the base's edge.
